raw: {"analysis":"Both responses address the key constraints well, but CBP provides a more coherent and complete delivery plan. CBP correctly identifies the need for joint review with Billing due to the shared schema, handles the flaky network check with appropriate retry limits, prohibits production-like data testing due to the 7-day backup window, and includes a feature flag rollback strategy. TRT also covers these constraints but introduces some unnecessary complexity (eight gates, train landing) and has a minor gap in not explicitly addressing the three isolated environments mentioned in the repository facts. CBP's plan is more actionable and better aligned with the actual operational constraints.","verdict":"CBP"}
